body.name: Monsters, Inc. Collection
body.overview: The Monsters, Inc. Collection is a heartwarming animated series set in a world powered by children's emotions. With imaginative storytelling, quirky characters, and vibrant visuals, it explores friendship, fear, and personal growth through the lens of lovable monsters navigating unexpected challenges.

parts.title: Monsters, Inc.
parts.overview: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the monsters who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.

parts.title: Monsters University
parts.overview: A look at the relationship between Mike and Sulley during their days at Monsters University — when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.
